protocol.cache: Fresh randomized build environment identifier per arm and set. OS, executable and file caches uncontrolled.
protocol.intervals: Each wall interval starts before the Windows accountant and its gated launcher and ends after both requests and receipt validation. Preparation, cleanup and independent marker reads are outside these intervals.
protocol.cpu: Compiler CPU is process_time per unique compiler. Windows Job Object BasicAccountingInfo independently covers the full local trial tree including its launcher, wrapper, clients, local compilers and SSH. The Node recorder, outer Python accountant, unrelated processes and remote Linux ancestors are excluded. The two CPU counters overlap for local builds and must not be added.
protocol.product: Last-round marshal bytes of each of four shipped Python modules hashed; every pair validates every digest against an independent interpreter invocation.
protocol.guard: Remote jobs entered through normal Swarm receiver admission. No foreground CAD frames, production changes or cloud runtimes.
